purpose: Validation-only high-dimensional test of a short-token latent temporal Mamba whose AutoCon representation and forecast residual share the same Mamba states.
research_question: Can a 24-token latent temporal Mamba retain competitive Electricity/Traffic H96 validation accuracy while improving the fixed-shape prediction cost of the current stride-24 relation-auxiliary MambaTSv3 candidate?
evidence_boundary: This is a validation-only exploratory matrix. Every job disables the test loader; no test metric, prediction file, stream metric, or held-out decision may be produced or inspected.
claim_boundary: A favorable result can authorize a separately reviewed fresh-seed confirmation plan only. It cannot establish held-out accuracy, universal speed, universal architecture superiority, or a causal AutoCon claim.

required_before_launch: verify Electricity and Traffic fingerprints and exact 60-job expansion
verify the two latent-temporal fixed-shape resource records
freeze candidate, null, reference, baseline, optimizer, normalization and seed contracts
keep skip_test=true and save_predictions=false for every job

resource_preflight.protocol: RTX 5090 D, FP32, device-resident B32/L96/H96 synthetic prediction-only forwards, 25 warm-up and 100 timed forwards; AutoCon auxiliary representation and relation loss excluded.
resource_preflight.representation_contract: All four records must report prediction_plus_auxiliary_representation, auxiliary representation requested/controlled/returned=true, and shape [32,96,64].
resource_preflight.speed_gate: The validation candidate must remain faster than the stride-24 MambaTSv3 reference on both registered shapes when the AutoCon representation path is included. Resource timing is not training throughput.

selection_contract.freeze_rule: No held-out signal, dataset-specific width change, lambda tuning, horizon change, seed replacement or speed result may alter the registered arms after launch.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms share chronological split, M features, L96/H96, optimizer, scheduler, batch size, epoch cap, patience, normalization and seeds.
capacity_fairness_contract.candidate_boundary: LatentTemporalMambaAutoCon uses a DLinear-style full-channel base plus one 24-token latent Mamba-1 residual. Its active and lambda-zero arms are architecturally identical and differ only in AutoCon_lambda.
capacity_fairness_contract.reference_boundary: MambaTSv3AutoCon is the frozen stride-24 relation-auxiliary reference, with the same public budget and active AutoCon weight but its own registered patch-token architecture.
capacity_fairness_contract.baseline_boundary: DLinear, NLinear, RLinear, PatchTST, TimesNet, iTransformer and Mamba2 do not receive candidate-only AutoCon or latent-state settings.

phases.name: latent_temporal_null_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Exact AutoCon-capable latent-temporal architecture with zero AutoCon weight.

phases.name: latent_temporal_active_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Identical latent-temporal architecture with the registered active AutoCon representation-learning weight.

phases.name: mambatsv3_reference_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Current stride-24 relation-auxiliary MambaTSv3 AutoCon reference using the same fresh validation coordinates.

phases.name: strong_baselines_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Same-coordinate linear, patch, Transformer and plain Mamba-2 comparators.

primary_contrasts: active versus exact lambda-zero latent-temporal control
active versus every registered strong baseline
comparison_contract.reporting_rule: Report every paired coordinate and failure. Fixed-shape resources remain a separate claim from training elapsed time.

stopping_rules: Do not produce or inspect held-out artifacts.
Stop the candidate if active AutoCon fails to improve its exact lambda-zero control on both datasets by paired mean direction and at least two of three seeds on either dataset.
Do not promote the candidate if it is more than 2% worse than the strongest external baseline on either dataset.
Do not promote the candidate if its fixed-shape latency is not lower than the CPU-4 stride-24 MambaTSv3 reference on both registered shapes.
Do not infer AutoCon causality from active-versus-external-baseline differences.
prelaunch_gates: verify the registered fixed-shape resource records and latency gate
freeze all architecture and optimization contracts
